name: Recruit (Paint)
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was available for the first time (only available for new accounts created during the event) in a special offer during the UFO Days event in June/July 2023.

This paint was available for the first time (to everyone) as a special offer "Secret Wish" (which consisted 200 epic keys + Recruit paint for 100M crystals) during the 16th {GAME} Birthday and lasted from May 30th till June 27th
This paint is also obtainable through the Advent calendar offer during Autumn Festival 2025, purchasable for 4400 tankoins (including some other rewards).
